description: This file defines a sealed class 'Serializer' responsible for converting Document Object Model (DOM) objects into Document Description Language (DDL). It contains methods for writing formatted and indented text, managing block structures, and handling stream output, with specific support for comments, attributes, and content serialization. Its primary function is to facilitate the serialization process within the MigraDoc library.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: Provides functionality for serializing Document Object Model objects into DDL with support for indentation, comments, block management, and stream writing.

methods.name: IncreaseIndent
methods.description: Increases indentation level for DDL code.

methods.name: DecreaseIndent
methods.description: Decreases indentation level for DDL code.

methods.name: WriteStamp
methods.description: Writes header comments with creation info and timestamp, if enabled.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Appends a string to the output with optional word wrapping.

methods.name: WriteLine
methods.description: Writes a string as a line, with optional word wrapping.

methods.name: DoWordWrap
methods.description: Determines how to wrap text at the current line.

methods.name: WriteLine
methods.description: Writes an empty line.

methods.name: WriteLineNoCommit
methods.description: Writes a line without marking it as part of committed text.

methods.name: WriteComment
methods.description: Writes a comment line, automatically wrapping if necessary.

methods.name: CloseUpLine
methods.description: Ends the current line if not already at line start.

methods.name: WriteToStream
methods.description: Effectively writes text to the stream with indentation and wrapping.

methods.name: WriteToStream
methods.description: Writes text directly to stream without breaking.

methods.name: WriteLineToStream
methods.description: Writes a line to the stream.

methods.name: BeginAttributes
methods.description: Starts attribute section with optional string.

methods.name: EndAttributes
methods.description: Ends attribute section.

methods.name: WriteSimpleAttribute
methods.description: Serializes a simple attribute value of various supported types.

methods.name: BeginContent
methods.description: Starts content section with optional string.

methods.name: EndContent
methods.description: Ends content section.

methods.name: BeginBlock
methods.description: Begins a new nested block.

methods.name: EndBlock
methods.description: Ends the current nested block.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Gets or sets the current position within the stream.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the stream buffer.

methods.name: Ind
methods.description: Creates a string of spaces for indentation.

methods.name: Indentation
methods.description: Returns the current indentation as a string.

methods.name: CommitText
methods.description: Marks the current block as containing serialized data.
